repos_data.description: WebSocket and WAMP in Python for Twisted and asyncio

The German Real-Time Mobility Context Platform for AI: live motorways, rail and public transport, EV charging, fuel, parking and weather warnings in any AI assistant. No API key, no sign-up. Streamable HTTP: https://mcp.viafrei.de/mcp, legacy SSE: https://mcp.viafrei.de/sse. This repo is the stdio bridge (npx viafrei).
